answer: Recursive ZK reputation commitments bind each node to a Merkle-rooted history while a stake-weighted VDF forces any Sybil clone to expend sequential work proportional to collateral. A 10^6 token stake is slashed by a penalty matching the attacker's expected gain, and the ZK-VDF output serves as a public echo yielding negative expected attack utility. This yields a robust Nash equilibrium where rational agents wander the lagoon of protocol state without profitable deviation.
